Jiangsu DOMT Sealing Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in March 2014, and its factory is located in Changzhou, Jiangsu. The founding team has been focused on the sealing business since 2014, and the factory began full production in January 2017. As an innovative company specializing in sealing manufacturing, the company integrates R&D, production, sales, and service. Drawing on domestically leading technical design concepts, it has developed over more than a decade and now operates a complete set of advanced sealing production lines. Product quality reaches the advanced level of comparable products at home and abroad, with monthly capacity of up to 15 million pieces and annual output value of 200 million yuan.
The company has established a DOMT Sealing R&D Center, placing great emphasis on research, development, and innovation. It has filed for and obtained more than one hundred national patents, covering utility-model patents for products such as transmission oil seals, automotive wheel hub oil seals, combination oil seals for motors, integrated heating plates, and oil seals dedicated to food processors, as well as invention patents for a sealing performance test device for multi-lip rotary oil seals, PTFE oil seal molds, and others.
In terms of management system development, the Changzhou factory obtained ISO 14001 environmental management system certification in May 2024, implemented ISO 9001 quality management system certification in 2019, and obtained IATF 16949 quality system certification at the end of 2023. In 2025, the company further obtained ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system certification and QC 080000 hazardous substance process management system certification, reinforcing the foundation for healthy long-term development of the enterprise across the board. In addition, in 2020 the Jiangsu company was recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise, a Jiangsu Province Science and Technology-Based SME, and a Jiangsu Province Private Technology Enterprise, and its brand influence continues to grow.
Going forward, DOMT will continue to strengthen its core strengths in product R&D and internationally oriented manufacturing quality, integrate global resources, and commit to designing and manufacturing higher-quality sealing system products. Its core business covers the R&D, manufacturing, sales, and technical services of rotary oil seals, reciprocating oil seals, water seals, pneumatic and hydraulic seals, O-rings, and molded products. Its products are widely used in many industries, including automotive, motorcycles, agricultural and construction machinery, home appliances, drones, robotics, new energy, medical, petroleum, petrochemical, and the State Grid.

江苏多密特密封制品有限公司于2014年3月成立，工厂坐落于江苏常州。创始团队自2014年起便深耕密封件领域，工厂于2017年1月正式投产。作为一家专注密封件制造的创新型企业，公司集研发、生产、销售与服务于一体，凭借国内领先的技术设计理念，历经十余年发展，现已拥有先进的整套密封件生产线。产品品质达国内外同类产品先进水平，月产能可达1500万件，年产值达2亿元。
公司设立多密特密封件研发中心，高度重视研发与创新，先后申请并获得一百余项国家专利，涵盖变速箱用油封、汽车轮毂油封、电机用组合油封、一体式发热盘及料理机专用油封等产品专利，以及多唇口旋转油封的密封性测试装置、聚四氟乙烯油封模具等发明专利。
在管理体系建设方面，常州工厂2024年5月通过IS014001环境管理体系认证，2019年实施井通过ISO9001质量管理体系认证，2023年底通过IATF16949质量体系认证。2025年，公司进一步获得IS045001职业健康安全管理体系认证与 QC080000有害物质过程管理体系认证，全方位旁实企业健康发展根基。此外，2020 年江苏公司获评国家高新技术企业、江苏省科技型中小企业以及江苏省民营
科技企业，品牌影响力持续扩大。
未来，多密特将持续强化产品研发与国际化制造品质的核心优势，整合全球资源，致力于设计制造更优质的密封系统产品。其主营业务覆盖旋转油封、往复油封、水封、气动和液压密封、型圈、模压制品的研发、制造、销售及技术服务，产品广泛应用于汽车、摩托车、农业及工程机械、家电、无人机、机器人、新能源、医疗、石油、石化、国家电网等众多行业。
